title: RepStateView
description: Data of each `state`/`end` event of GET /ui/sessions/{session_id}/reps: the live repetition counter of the desktop UI. Codes and numbers, never prose. A session is made of sets of repetitions: rep and total count repetitions of the whole session (rep 1 to 60), set and rep_in_set place the repetition inside its set (set 1 to 4, rep_in_set 1 to 15). With no signal the counter is never shown frozen as if there were signal: phase and progress_pct are null, rep and last are kept. A session that is over has signal ok (it did not lose its sensor) with phase and progress_pct null, rep and last kept, in both its final `state` and its `end`.

rep.description: Repetitions completed plus the current one; 0 when none has started yet.

total.description: planned_reps (TOTAL, all sets) of the session, otherwise total_reps of the protocol catalog; null when neither is known.

set.description: Set (1-based) of the current repetition; while resting between two sets, the set that just ended. 0 when none has started yet.

sets_total.description: planned_sets of the session, otherwise planned_sets of the protocol catalog; null when neither is known.

reps_per_set.description: reps_per_set of the session, otherwise of the protocol catalog; null when neither is known.

rep_in_set.description: Repetitions completed plus the current one inside `set`; 0 when none has started yet. Between two sets it keeps the last repetition of the set that ended (rep_in_set equals reps_per_set) while phase is resting.

phase.description: pulling, letting_up or resting (between repetitions, or between two sets); null when there is no signal or the session is over.

progress_pct.description: Movement angle relative to the peak of the previous repetition, 0 to 100; null in the first repetition (the range is not known yet), while resting, when there is no signal and when the session is over.

last.description: Last completed repetition; null when none is complete.

signal.description: ok, or no_signal when the imu_t9 stream is not delivering.
